memories.content: The recurring atlas release build cancellations (2026-08-11, 2026-08-19, 2026-08-29) are caused by the 30-minute CI job timeout combined with every release build starting from an empty cargo registry cache, which alone costs ~18 minutes; this leaves little margin so normal build-time variance pushes jobs past the cutoff. Fix: persist/restore the cargo registry (and ideally target/) cache between release builds, keyed on Cargo.lock, rather than raising the timeout.
